system.description: Tideborn are aquatic and amphibious peoples whose bodies are adapted to oceans, rivers, swamps, reefs, flooded caverns, and other submerged environments. Tideborn may resemble fish, amphibians, marine mammals, cephalopods, crustaceans, aquatic reptiles, or beings with no terrestrial equivalent.

nature.name: Amphibious Body
nature.text: Gain Swim 10. You can breathe both air and water and function normally while submerged. Ordinary water pressure, currents, and temperature within habitable depths do not impair you. Choose one Tideborn Species Trait.

traits.name: Adhesive Limbs
traits.text: Gain Climb 10 through suckers, gripping pads, hooked limbs, or a similar adaptation. You may remain secured to a surface without using your hands.

traits.name: Bioluminescence
traits.text: During your Turn, you may begin or suppress your bodily light without an Action. It provides clear light within 1 unit and dim light out to 2 units. To leave a luminous mark on an adjacent creature or object during Combat, use Perform Task and burn its normal 2 Action dice. An unattended object or willing creature needs no roll. Against an unwilling creature, roll Grace + an applicable Non-Combat Skill against its Fortitude. Use Grace + 5 for a directly applicable Key Aspect, or Grace alone if no Skill applies. This specific use of Perform Task is non-damaging, produces no Surges, and permits legal Reactions before resolution. On success, the mark lasts until the Encounter ends or someone within reach uses Perform Task to remove it. Ordinary darkness cannot conceal the marked subject, but cover, opaque barriers, and other concealment still can.

traits.name: Echolocation
traits.text: Within 3 units, you can emit and hear brief echoes to pinpoint exposed shapes and movement despite visual darkness, smoke, or similar visual concealment. Echolocation reveals no color, writing, or fine visual detail. It requires a continuous air or water path carrying sound to the subject and back; solid barriers and effects preventing emission or hearing block it. The emitted sound can itself be heard. It functions passively and costs no dice.

traits.name: Electric Sense
traits.text: While submerged, detect the presence and approximate direction and distance of living creatures within 3 units through the electrical activity of their bodies. You and the subject must share a continuous body of water; a sealed barrier or an effect blocking electrical sensing prevents detection. Visual concealment does not interfere. This Sense does not reveal identity, condition, or an exact occupied space for targeting; use another Sense or a deliberate search to locate the creature precisely.

traits.name: Flexible Body
traits.text: You may pass through openings your flexible body and equipment can actually fit through, bypassing the usual one-Size squeezing limit. Apply the normal squeezing Movement cost and −1 Fortitude. You may move through creatures’ spaces but cannot end in a space still occupied by a conscious creature, or pass through sealed barriers.

traits.name: Ink Cloud
traits.text: Gain the Ink Cloud Species Combat Card under Species Combat Cards later in this chapter. Once per Encounter while submerged, it creates one adjacent hex of opaque ink that blocks ordinary sight.

traits.name: Jet Propulsion
traits.text: Increase your Swim Movement to 12. The first time you Dash while swimming during each turn, move 1 additional unit.
